heightmap_absence_frontier.current: terrain_heightmap_image replaces absent height with the minimum, and encoded_terrain_heightmap_image always writes alpha=255.
heightmap_absence_frontier.finding: Both shaders decode red/green unconditionally, so changing only alpha would not make unsupported texels explicit. Do not claim an alpha marker fixes this chain.
heightmap_absence_frontier.pre_edit_requirement: Choose and implement a complete producer-to-shader absence contract or reject an incomplete required image before publishing it. Preserve all existing supported-texel interpolation/quantization and optional visual authority. Do not merely rewrap the fabricated minimum as SupportElevation.
